name: EH3D-PHOENIX-PCB
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.4: early code. EDA environment planned as schematic capture, PCB layout, verification tools, circuit simulation and specialized modules for switch-mode power supplies and RF; it is the main project of the PHOENIX family. What exists is a Rust workspace: a redacted inventory of a private corpus, the design model foundations, the .phoenixproj project file, the board model with silkscreen and reversible operations, connectivity and rule checks, the schematic model with a drawing, a reader of EAGLE XML with a measured read rate, a writer and reader of boards as EAGLE XML, the contract for pairs of EAGLE binary files, the Gerber and Excellon export, a viewer and editor prototype whose window has never been seen on a screen, and a command line. All of it has been tried on generated or hand-made data only; the editors, the readers of foreign designs and the reader of the EAGLE binary files are not written and nothing has been run on a machine.
